name: Form – waitlist
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Form – waitlist.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: ARIA label
settings.how: Enter the aria label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Template
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for template. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Surface chrome
settings.info: Inline always uses a minimal frameless surface. Card and Split use this setting.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for surface chrome. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Split image
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.how: Write the subheading. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Show first name field
settings.how: Turn on “Show first name field” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Bind mode
settings.info: Auto syncs a uniquely identified product purchase form on the matching product page. The waitlist picker remains available; unrelated forms and quick views are ignored.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for bind mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Product handle (optional override)
settings.info: Defaults to the current product on product pages. Elsewhere choose a published handle. Missing/unpublished products leave the form unavailable; variants render natively without a network request.
settings.how: Enter the product handle (optional override). Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Privacy link (URL)
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Privacy link label
settings.how: Enter the privacy link label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Destination
settings.info: Shopify Customer is an email marketing signup. Automated restock delivery requires a configured notification integration or a custom endpoint that processes inventory events. Match storefront copy to the service actually enabled.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for destination. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Custom endpoint URL (HTTPS)
settings.info: The endpoint must process the POST, consent, captcha and notification service. Variant ID is submitted natively; label and enriched tags require JavaScript.
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Hidden tags (comma-separated)
settings.how: Enter the hidden tags (comma-separated). Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Captcha
settings.info: Custom endpoints only, with server verification. Native Customer signup uses Shopify spam protection.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for captcha. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Captcha site key
settings.how: Advanced: enter the existing metafield key or content field key described below. Match the spelling exactly and use the data type expected by this section. Use manual content first if no matching definition exists. This is an optional external integration. Configure the corresponding service first; the setting does not provision a service or guarantee delivery. Public site keys must be restricted to the intended domain. Native Shopify forms remain available without this integration.
